name: Discrete Boundary Equation Masking
description: Replaces a local edge-wise polynomial evaluation with a vertex-wise linear equation that holds true for a trivial continuous solution (r=1.5), but whose discrete domain bounds (r in {1, 2}) strictly force the bipartite property. This defeats pattern-matching models because evaluating discrete combinations on a vertex-wise sum of arbitrary degree is structurally harder than on a single edge, and generic linear solvers will fail due to the trivial continuous solution not being valid.
